{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Steve and Tony.png|thumb|250px|Tony and Steve]] '''Steve''' (Japanese: '''スティーブ''' ''Steve'') and '''Tony''' (Japanese: '''トニー''' ''Tony'') are the assistants of [[Visquez]], the stand-in [[Gym Leader]] at the [[Vermilion Gym]] while [[Lt. Surge]] is absent. ==In animation== In {{aniseries|JN}}, Steve and Tony are characters who appeared in ''[[JN018|Destination: Coronation!]]'', with Tony also appearing in ''[[JN030|Betrayed, Bothered, and Beleaguered!]]''. They are in charge of cleaning up the [[Gym]] after a {{pkmn|battle}} has occurred. Tony also acts as [[Battle judge|referee]] during Gym battles, while Steve keeps track of Visquez's [[World Coronation Series]] ranking and potential challengers. After winning a Gym battle, Visquez was eager to challenge someone participating in the World Coronation Series to improve her ranking. Steve announced that a challenger was nearby, which turned out to be {{Ash}}. During Visquez's battle against Ash, they watched the battles from the stands, as World Coronation Series battles are refereed by a [[Drone Rotom]]. Visquez ultimately lost the battle, and her rank subsequently dropped, much to the dismay of Steve and Tony. In ''Betrayed, Bothered, and Beleaguered!'', Tony had his own World Coronation Series match against Ash. He used his {{p|Electabuzz}} against [[Ash's Riolu]] but lost, causing his ranking to go down. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Steve and Tony's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|JN}}: ====Tony==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tony |pkmn=Electabuzz |type1=Electric |img=Tony Electabuzz.png |epnum=JN030 |epname=Betrayed, Bothered, and Beleaguered! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Electabuzz}} is Tony's only known Pokémon. It was used to face [[Ash's Riolu]] in a [[World Coronation Series]] battle and was defeated with a {{m|Vacuum Wave}}.
